content.text: Describe only the visible setting, windows, device lights and people. Return one JSON object.

scene.description: Visible setting only; aircraft_cabin means inside an airplane passenger cabin.

visible_windows.description: Number of visible airplane windows, including partly occluded windows.

device_lights_on.description: Whether the tall rectangular device has visible illuminated lights.

people_visible.description: Whether any person is visible in the image.
